state.seed_assertion: ICO consultation is not required if a DPIA identified high risk but mitigating measures have reduced it to no longer be high.

sentences.1: If you have determined that the processing is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of data subjects, you must carry out a data protection impact assessment (DPIA) for each processing operation.
sentences.2: A DPIA does not have to indicate that all risks have been eradicated.
sentences.3: Organizations have an overriding obligation under Article 35(1) to assess any proposed processing operation against the requirement to complete DPIAs regardless of provided high-risk lists.
sentences.4: You cannot begin the processing until you have consulted us.
sentences.5: Once we have the information we need, we will generally respond within eight weeks (although we can extend this by a further six weeks in complex cases).
sentences.6: You have already done a substantially similar DPIA.
sentences.7: This means that although you have not yet assessed the actual level of risk, you need to screen for factors that point to the potential for a widespread or serious impact on individuals.
sentences.8: You have already done a substantially similar DPIA.
